run_check_co3d_sha256: run the CLI to verify SHA256 checksums of CO3D dataset zip files in a download folder
run_main_checksum_validation: run the main function to validate all zip file checksums against expected SHA256 hashes
run_sha256_file_hash: run sha256_file to compute the SHA256 hash digest of a single file path
run_get_expected_sha256s: run get_expected_sha256s to load expected checksums from a JSON file for full or single-sequence subsets
run_check_single_file: run check_co3d_sha256 to verify a single zip file checksum against expected values with optional assertion
